description: Your own submitted posts across all campaigns — status, views, earnings, campaign, account and submission date, plus a summary (total, on-moderation, total earned). Requires the read scope. Optional filters: status, platform.

cursor.description: Numeric cursor from a previous page (nextCursor).

platform.description: Filter by platform, e.g. INSTAGRAM_REELS, TIKTOK.

status.description: Filter by status, e.g. IN_MODERATION, ACCEPTED, REJECTED.

name: vibevo_list_my_posts
title: List my submitted posts (creator)
